What every prophet taught

One straight path

The path is one, and God guides whoever truly wants it and walks toward it.

The Quran's opening prayer asks for one thing: guide us on the straight path. The Psalms ask in nearly the same words, and in the Quran Jesus says of worshipping God: this is a straight path. A path asks two things of you: to want it, and to walk. Guidance and safety come from God, and He gives them to those who seek Him and strive. Anyone, from anywhere, can begin today.

﴿ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Guide us to the straight path -

Quran · Al-Fatihah 1:6

﴿وَأَنَّ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:153

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path.'"

Quran · Aal Imran 3:51

﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.

Quran · Al-Ankabut 29:69

﴿وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allāh].

Quran · Al-Isra 17:19

You might ask

QuestionIf guidance is from God, what is my part?
AnswerTo want it and to walk. The Quran speaks of one who seeks the life to come and strives for it with faith, and says that effort will be thanked.Quran · Al-Isra 17:19
QuestionWho is guidance for?
AnswerFor whoever turns toward God. The Quran promises that those who strive for Him will be shown His ways, and that He is with those who do good.Quran · Al-Ankabut 29:69
QuestionWhose path is it?
AnswerGod's. The Quran calls it His path and warns that side roads scatter people. No people owns it, and it is open to all.Quran · Al-An'am 6:153

Want it, take one step, and ask God for the next.
